name: stack
summary: Manage stacked pull requests on GitHub.
best_for: Teams that split large changes into dependent PRs.

name: pr-review
summary: View, navigate, reply to, and resolve PR review threads.
best_for: Reviewers who want inline PR review workflows in the terminal.
avoid_if: Your team reviews exclusively in the GitHub web UI.

name: milestone
summary: Manage GitHub milestones from the terminal.
best_for: Maintainers who use milestones for release planning.
avoid_if: Your project does not use GitHub milestones.

name: sherpa
summary: Create branches and pull requests from Jira or GitHub issues.
best_for: Teams that connect issue tracking to branch and PR creation.
avoid_if: You do not use structured issue-based workflows.

name: metrics
best_for: Maintainers who track review and merge health.
avoid_if: You only need individual PR details.

name: prism
summary: Review pull requests from GitHub CLI.
best_for: Developers who want a focused PR review helper.
avoid_if: You need full project management features.

name: dependabot
summary: Review Dependabot pull requests from GitHub CLI.
best_for: Teams that process many dependency update pull requests.

name: dep
summary: Bulk manage dependency pull requests in a TUI.
best_for: Teams with many Dependabot or Renovate pull requests.
avoid_if: You rarely receive dependency update PRs.

name: i
best_for: Maintainers searching issues without opening the browser.
avoid_if: You need project-management features beyond search.

name: sql
summary: Query GitHub Projects data with SQL.
best_for: Advanced users exploring GitHub Projects data.
avoid_if: You want a beginner-friendly project dashboard.

name: triage
summary: Triage GitHub issues from the terminal.
avoid_if: You need an actively maintained triage tool.
